source.path: Wolfe et al. /Wolfe et al experimental data.csv
source.provenance_read_before_freeze: paper abstract/methods, author README, author R analysis scripts, CSV header only

design.primary_risk_set: Only 4- and 6-patch treatments (omit single-patch where heterogeneity has no contrast)

endpoints.primary_joint: 1 if both generalist and specialist are present in SAME microcosm at day 21; NOT necessarily same patch
endpoints.unknown_values: STOP; no imputation and no posthoc threshold relaxation

contrast.estimand: mean across 18 equal-weight strata (2 patch counts x 3 matrix x 3 corridor) of [joint prevalence in heterogeneous - joint prevalence in homogeneous] using 4 independently assigned microcosms per arm
contrast.primary: joint guild day-21 presence, size-heterogeneity contrast within same patch count and dispersal treatments
contrast.uncertainty: 10,000 stratified within-cell experiment-unit bootstraps, each 18x2x4 groups resampled separately; percentile 2.5 and 97.5
secondary: joint contrast separately within 4 and 6 patches
contrast.allowed_interpretation: retrospective final-day treatment-conditioned co-presence, not source-loss dynamics, not dispersal route identification
